feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
entry.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

entry.title: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
entry.summary: Little is known about her except that she's reportedly about 13 and named Kim Ju Ae, but Korea's spy agency says she's likely her father's heir.

entry.title: Indonesia's VP offers resignation as questions mount over his eligibility
entry.summary: His resignation offer comes amid a widening political rift between Prabowo and Widodo and a separate investigation into allegations that senior police officials wiretapped the president.

entry.title: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
entry.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

entry.title: Seven days of chaos in the ER: How this country's healthcare system is unraveling
entry.summary: Renewed fighting has pushed Ethiopia's healthcare system close to collapse: "The whole emergency (room) was flooded with war trauma patients," one surgeon says of a brutal week in September.

entry.title: Get in, loser: Broadway's newest 'Mean Girls' are ready to insult (and enlighten) you
entry.summary: "School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play," is ending a Broadway run this week and celebrating with livestream broadcasts. We interviewed the Tony-nominated playwright, Jocelyn Bioh.

entry.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
entry.summary: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.

entry.title: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
entry.summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.

entry.title: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
entry.summary: Hopes of progress in ending Europe's biggest conflict since World War II are tempered by the absence of any significant breakthroughs in three previous rounds of talks early this year.

entry.title: House Republicans to elect a new leader as they look to rebuild from midterm defeat
entry.summary: After sweeping losses in the midterm elections, the House GOP will vote on Tuesday to elect a successor to Mike Johnson, who says he's stepping down as the chamber's top Republican.
